_README: THE ONE FILE TO EDIT WHEN PRICES CHANGE.
Two different products are priced here, and they are not the same thing:
prepaidPrice — ONE charge, buys `months` of access, nothing renews.
Charged by us through PayPal Orders v2 at exactly this
value, so this number IS what the member pays.
monthlyPrice — the per-cycle price of the matching FIXED-TERM PayPal
subscription (bills monthly, stops after `months`
cycles). PayPal charges whatever is stored in the PLAN,
not what is written here, so changing this number only
changes the price the site DISPLAYS. To change what is
actually billed you must create a new plan:
`node scripts/paypal-setup-plans.mjs --terms --live`
and paste the new id into planEnvVar.
PRICES BELOW ARE PROPOSALS, not owner-approved. The 12-month numbers
match the documented $50/yr Pro and $100/yr Studio targets. The 3- and
6-month prepaid numbers are a guess at the shape of the discount
(3mo = no discount, 6mo = 10% off, 12mo = ~17% off).
monthlyPrice deliberately carries NO discount: the discount is what you
get for handing over the money up front. It must also be exactly
representable in two decimal places, which a discounted 12-cycle price
A term is only sellable when it appears here. A FIXED-TERM SUBSCRIPTION
is additionally only offered once its planEnvVar is set in the
environment — until then the site shows the prepaid option alone.
